through. With the genitive of space or place through which someone or something passes.
said of time through which something happens or lasts
διά with the genitive of the person or thing through which something happens
διά with the genitive signifying the reason by which something happens
διά through, with the accusative. Of the place which someone traverses
διά with the accusative, on account of.
It is often used for ἐν with the dative in the expression διὰ χειρὸς ἔχειν [to have in hand] and similar ones, which are collected in Thes. vol. 2 p. 1100 and in the Lexicon Soph. p. 117.
